definition: A graph of paired data, where each pair of values is plotted as one cross, with one variable on each axis, so you can see whether the two are linked.

How two variables are linked, seen in the pattern of a scatter diagram: positive when one tends to increase as the other increases, negative when one tends to decrease as the other increases, and zero when there is no upward or downward trend.
A single straight line, drawn by eye with a ruler, that follows the trend of the points on a scatter diagram, with about as many points on each side of it.
